issues.fingerprint: gates::hero-motion validator resists case and false-token bypasses
issues.invariant: the video-emitter allowlist can't be defeated by tag case or a token merely present in the file
issues.seen_by: Agent A (Ultracode static red team round 2, resumed: 8/8 finders, partial verification due to two account-wide credit exhaustions mid-run)
issues.observation: The allowlist added for ISS-011 matched only the lowercase substring '<video' and treated any occurrence of the resolver token as proof of wiring, so an uppercase <VIDEO> tag in an unlisted template, or a resolver token present without a real assignment, would still pass.
issues.resolution: Detection is now case-insensitive (re.search on <\s*video\b, IGNORECASE); a callable resolver token additionally requires a $var = token( assignment in its resolver file. Negative-probed: an uppercase <VIDEO> in an unlisted template now raises ValueError; the real tree still passes. Residual gap (documented, not fixed): a regex can't distinguish an active call from one inside a PHP comment — accepted, out of scope for a static gate. bug-374.

issues.fingerprint: performance::asset-version cache-bust avoids per-request GLB hashing
issues.invariant: the cache-bust token for a binary asset costs O(1) I/O per request, not O(file size)
issues.seen_by: Agent A (Ultracode static red team round 2, resumed: 8/8 finders, partial verification due to two account-wide credit exhaustions mid-run)
issues.observation: skyyrose2_asset_version() ran hash_file('sha256', …) on the full file on every request with no cross-request cache; the Skyy dock alone pulls 3.3 MB across two GLBs, so every page load paid a full-file SHA-256 read.
issues.resolution: Binaries over 256 KB now version on filemtime()+filesize() (sha1 of the pair, 12-char prefix) instead of hashing file contents; smaller assets (CSS/JS) keep content hashing. Cache still busts correctly on any real file replace.
